diagnosis.cause: The presentation commit released the native-select hold but not its initiating pointer hold. When a platform picker consumed the document pointerup that committed an option, the updated filtered data could arrive while repaint remained queued until the next outside pointer sequence.
diagnosis.evidenceLimit: The consumed-release sequence is a labelled synthetic causal reproduction, not an observed event trace from the owner's browser or native OS popup automation.
diagnosis.correction: An explicit select commit now clears the initiating pointer and pending-release delay together with the native-select hold. The work-item filter retains its native change semantics.
